title: ToolDisplay
description: How a tool is named to people (TOOLNAMES): the built-in tools' action labels, the toolsets' display names, and the words the fallback humanizer writes in capitals. One registry the Slack bot and the web client name tools from; the rules are pinned by contracts/harness/vectors/tool-display-names.json. Generated as TOOL_DISPLAY in every target.

builtins.description: Built-in tools, by their bare name (no source, toolset or dynamic prefix): what the step says while it runs and once it ran. The web client reads the same words from i18n `toolNames.<key>.present|past`; these are its English fallback and the Slack bot's words.

toolsets.description: A toolset's display name by the prefix its tools carry (`github__…`, `pipeshub@github/…`), where title-casing the prefix would read wrong.

hiddenToolsets.description: Prefixes that are plumbing, not an app a person knows (`dynamic`, `internaltools`): the step names no app for them.

acronyms.description: Words the humanizer writes as given (`url` → URL, `ids` → IDs).

tools.description: The tool's bare names: PipesHub's, and an engine's own tools as the engine names them (Claude Code's `Glob`, Gemini CLI's `read_file`, WP-112).
